summary: As of 2026-10-01, Martin Shkreli is assessed as ADVERSE with 98% confidence. The decisive facts are: he was convicted of securities fraud and conspiracy (a felony) and that conviction remains on record; he has not received a pardon despite a request; and a court ordered him to return $64.6 million in profits from the Daraprim price hike, a material adverse civil judgment.

findings.statement: Martin Shkreli's felony conviction for securities fraud and conspiracy remains on record as of 2026-10-01, with no pardon or vacatur.
Martin Shkreli has not been pardoned; he only requested a pardon that was not granted as of 2026-10-01.
Martin Shkreli faces a material adverse civil judgment requiring him to return $64.6 million in profits from the Daraprim price increase.
Martin Shkreli is known by the alias 'Pharma Bro'.

minor_adverse_items: Martin Shkreli was released from FCI Fort Dix in September 2022 (specifically September 14, 2022). (unrated; federalcriminaldefenseattorney.com)
